_comment: Canonical crafting data for the v2 Unity dungeon crafting system (Workstream C). Defines the collectible ingredient items and the recipes a crafting pedestal can fulfil. DATA ONLY — DeNelle.Dungeons hydrates the crafting pedestal, the ingredient pickups and the crafting UI from this. The Healer's Cottage ships ONE recipe: the torch. Loaded the same way as lore-fragments.json / healers-cottage.json (Newtonsoft.Json, StreamingAssets/Data/Canonical, via UniTask).

_sources.design: defenders-unity/docs/dungeon-3d-healers-cottage-design.md (the cottage is a healer's workshop — herbs, oil, resin, cloth)
_sources.layoutSpec: defenders-unity/docs/dungeons-3d-unity-layout-spec.md (the crafting shard pedestal in the Hidden Vault)
_sources.owner: defenders-unity/docs/qa/owner-acceptance-checklist.md (Dungeon — lantern & crafting: GAP — craft a torch, recipe + items needed, legible)

_schemaNotes.ingredients: Collectible crafting materials. 'id' keys the pickup placements + recipe entries. 'glyph' is a single-char UI stand-in until item icon art lands. 'tint' is an RRGGBB hex used by the scene builder for the pickup mote.
_schemaNotes.recipes: Each recipe lists the ingredients (by id) and counts the pedestal needs. A recipe is craftable once the inventory holds at least every listed count.
_schemaNotes.ingredientPlacements: Where each ingredient pickup is dropped in the Healer's Cottage. position is X east(+)/west(-), Y up, Z south(+)/north(-) — same convention as healers-cottage.json.
_schemaNotes.pedestal: The crafting pedestal placement — replaces the §5.4 'crafting shard pedestal' placeholder primitive in the Hidden Vault.

ingredients.description: A bundle of brittle marsh reed from the garden's edge — the torch's haft.
A strip of linen steeped in lantern oil — it will hold a flame.
Hardened sap that catches at a spark — the heart of any torch.

recipes.description: A hand-held torch — steady light that never runs dry. Bind reed, cloth and resin at the pedestal.
recipes.craftedToast: The torch catches. Its light is yours, Keeper — and it will not fade.
